python3 << 'EOF'
import statistics

# Data in millions of dollars
years = [1961, 1962, 1963, 1964, 1965, 1966, 1967]
interest_charges_millions = [8769, 9534, 10141, 10931, 11488, 12533, 12972]

# Convert to billions for final answer
interest_charges_billions = [x / 1000 for x in interest_charges_millions]

# OLS: y = a + b*x
# slope (b) = sum((x-xbar)*(y-ybar)) / sum((x-xbar)^2)
# intercept (a) = ybar - b*xbar

n = len(years)
xbar = statistics.mean(years)
ybar = statistics.mean(interest_charges_billions)

# Calculate slope
numerator = sum((years[i] - xbar) * (interest_charges_billions[i] - ybar) for i in range(n))
denominator = sum((years[i] - xbar) ** 2 for i in range(n))
slope = numerator / denominator
intercept = ybar - slope * xbar

print(f"xbar: {xbar}")
print(f"ybar: {ybar}")
print(f"slope: {slope}")
print(f"intercept: {intercept}")

# Forecast FY 1968
forecast_1968 = intercept + slope * 1968
print(f"\nForecast FY 1968 (in billions): {forecast_1968}")

# Actual FY 1968 (in billions)
actual_1968 = 15.426  # from table, 15,426 million = 15.426 billion

print(f"Actual FY 1968 (in billions): {actual_1968}")

# Forecast error = actual - forecast
error = actual_1968 - forecast_1968
print(f"\nForecast error (actual - forecast) in billions: {error}")
print(f"Formatted to 6 decimal places: {error:.6f}")
EOF
